QUECHLNG 1: First Year First Quarter Quechua is the first course in a three quarter sequence. Course emphasizes development of basic level communication skills using daily life topics. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive and presentational modes of communication. Quechua culture.
QUECHLNG 2: Continuation of QUECHLNG 1. First Year Second Quarter Quechua is the second course in a three quarter sequence. Course emphasizes further development of basic level communication skills using daily life topics. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive and presentational modes of communication. Quechua culture.Prerequisite: QUECHLNG 1 or placement test.
QUECHLNG 3: Continuation of QUECHLNG 2. First Year Third Quarter Quechua is the third course in a three quarter sequence. Course emphasizes further development of basic level communication skills using daily life topics. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive and presentational modes of communication. Quechua culture. Prerequisite: QUECHLNG 2 or placement test. Completion of QUECHLNG 3 fulfills the University Language Requirement.
QUECHLNG 21: Continuation of QUECHLNG 3. Second Year Quechua, First Quarter in a three quarter sequence. The course integrates language and culture with an emphasis on developing proficiency in oral and written discourse. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio-culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. Prerequisite: QUECHLNG 3 or placement test.
QUECHLNG 22: Continuation of QUECHLNG 21. Second Year Quechua, Second Quarter in a three quarter sequence. The course integrates language and culture with an emphasis on further developing proficiency in oral and written discourse. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio-culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. Prerequisite: QUECHLNG 21 or placement test.
QUECHLNG 23: Continuation of QUECHLNG 22. Second Year Quechua, Third Quarter in a three quarter sequence. The course integrates language and culture with an emphasis on developing proficiency in oral and written discourse. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio-culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. Prerequisite: QUECHLNG 22 or placement test.
QUECHLNG 101: This is a third year first quarter course in Quechua language and culture, offered as a three quarter sequence. The course focuses on developing fluency and accuracy as students immerse in the use of the language in a range of situations. The course uses a thematic approach. Topics integrate elements of Quechua culture, review of relevant grammar concepts, and opportunities to use the language in real-world cultural contexts.
QUECHLNG 102: This is a third year second quarter course in Quechua language and culture, offered as a three quarter sequence. The course focuses on developing fluency and accuracy as students immerse in the use of the language in a range of situations. The course uses a thematic approach. Topics integrate elements of Quechua culture, review of relevant grammar concepts, and opportunities to use the language in real-world cultural contexts.
